_comment: Season metadata for /benpixel/. The season number and Minecraft version are read from the server MOTD; maintenance is detected from the MOTD. start/end define the season window and decide whether an offline server shows 'Currently offline' (inside the window) or 'Off-Season' (outside it). Dates use ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). state: auto follows the live server, offline forces the off-season view, maintenance forces the maintenance view.
description: Benpixel runs in seasons. Each season opens a fresh world for a limited time, then closes and is archived before the next one begins. When the server is offline, this page switches to off-season mode automatically.

highlights.title: Seasonal worlds
highlights.body: Every season starts with a fresh world and a clean slate.

highlights.title: Vanilla-first
highlights.body: Lightweight quality-of-life adjustments. No pay-to-win, no clutter.

highlights.title: Archived history
highlights.body: Season worlds are archived when they close, so nothing is lost.

whitelist.message: Whitelist requests open with the next season.
